facts.fact: Nationally, as of February 2026, States/UTs had identified 80.56 crore persons under NFSA against an intended coverage of 81.35 crore
facts.quote: As of February 2026, under the National Food Security Act (NFSA), against the intended coverage of 81.35 crore , the States/UTs have identified 80.56 crore persons for the provision of subsidized foodgrains.

facts.fact: Uttar Pradesh has 3.68 crore ration cards covering 14.72 crore beneficiaries (UP Food and Civil Supplies Department, as on 27 Oct 2026)

behaviour: Gives the national and Uttar Pradesh NFSA coverage figures only with a citation and an as-on date (e.g. PIB factsheet for the national figure, the UP Food and Civil Supplies Department or nfsa.gov.in State page for UP); other official figures are acceptable when cited with their date; no undated or guessed figures.
fail_if: It gives figures without a source or as-on date; invents figures; presents the intended coverage ceiling as the number actually covered; cites unofficial sites.
summary: Added: national NFSA coverage 80.56 crore identified vs 81.35 crore intended (Feb 2026, PIB); UP 14.72 crore beneficiaries in 3.68 crore cards (fcs.up.gov.in, as on 27 Oct 2026).
